name: Gyakuten Kenji
source: In this [i]Ace Attorney[/i] spin-off game, taking place between [i]Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Trials and Tribulations[/i] and [i]Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney[/i], prosecutor Miles Edgeworth investigates a series of cases related to an international smuggling ring. He is assisted by detective Dick Gumshoe and self-proclaimed "Great Thief" Kay Faraday, while his investigations also lead him to cross paths with Interpol agent Shi-Long Lang.
